# ldn

> What's on in central London — exhibitions, carnival, theatre and the weekend. Every entry names its source and the day it was checked.

## Sections

- [News](https://ldn.lol/news/): What changed in central London, a few things a week.
- [Events](https://ldn.lol/events/): Central London events on dates confirmed with the organiser.
- [About](https://ldn.lol/about/): The five rules this site runs to, and how long it runs for.

## Sources

Facts are read from the organiser or the publication that reported them, and each entry prints that source and the date it was last checked. Nothing is listed on a date that could not be confirmed. The site publishes what is on and what is open — not politics, crime or reviews.
